issues.description: Field mismatch for SealSaloon.orders: The problem statement explicitly requires a modifiable List<Meal> attribute named 'orders' in SealSaloon, but the provided implementation uses a Meal[] array for this attribute and helper methods (ArrayHelpers) to modify it. This contradicts the exercise text and UML and can confuse students about which collection type to implement and which APIs to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent across the problem statement and repository. Option A (preferred if arrays are intended): Update the problem statement and UML to require a modifiable Meal[] orders and mention/use ArrayHelpers in the description and examples. Option B (preferred if Java Collections are intended): Update the template and solution to use java.util.List<Meal> (e.g., ArrayList) for orders, remove or adapt ArrayHelpers usages, and update Main and UML examples accordingly. Ensure all instructions, examples, and tests consistently reference the chosen type.
